data_policy: No PHI. All Patient identifiers, names and observations are generated solely for the test run.

probes.name: concurrent-conditional-create

initial_http_statuses.transient_conflict_409: may occur only with the pinned HAPI duplicate HFJ_RES_SEARCH_URL primary-key diagnostic

conflict_recovery.retry_request: exact same POST /Patient body and If-None-Exist identifier
conflict_recovery.expected_retry_resource_id: same ID as the single original 201 creator

probes.qualification_note: First-attempt 409 rate must be recorded and reported, not hidden. Retry only an OperationOutcome whose diagnostics identify hfj_res_search_url_pkey. Every retry must return HTTP 200 for the exact original Patient ID. Any other 409, retry failure, ID mismatch or duplicate DB row fails the probe.

probes.name: deterministic-stale-if-match
probes.method: PUT resource with deliberately stale If-Match

probes.name: concurrent-version-conflict
probes.method: two simultaneous PUTs from same version

probes.name: transaction-rollback
probes.method: create marker and stale-version update within one transaction

boundaries: The FHIR transaction is atomic only within the supporting FHIR server.
A read-only SQL observer on the same database is independent of the FHIR API, not an independent database replica or third-party auditor.
The corpus does not exercise Mycelix consent-revocation commit fencing, gateway/outbox crash recovery, recipient-side durable effects, or production authentication.
